name: critter-seal
description: Opt-in guard that holds back a command sending a secret file or a key-shaped value to a host you have not listed. It matches shapes and never prints, stores or sends a secret. Best effort: it reads the command, not the traffic.

trustedHosts.title: Hosts you trust
trustedHosts.description: Comma-separated hosts a command may send secrets to, with their subdomains. Anything else is held back.
